name: Play in editor starts at the editor's viewpoint, with the open level

comments.text: Done 2026-11-20 (D-231). The card was filed as the work finished, not before. Play saves a scratch copy with a play_start entity at the selected entity or the editor camera; the game drops it to the ground, skips the title screen, and puts the partner and companion beside the player. Open: the partner starts at the nearest beat, so a lever an earlier beat would have worked is not worked for the player. Room streaming (D-228) should check that play_start lands in the right room.
